name: zrndr_set_palette_shade_recipe_index
description: zRndr_SetPaletteShadeRecipeIndex stores the palette-remap recipe index for shade remapping or -1 when disabled.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs produced symbol ?zRndr_SetPaletteShadeRecipeIndex@@YIXPAUzVidPaletteRemapRecipe@@@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x499a00 after COFF relocation masking (12 relocation bytes, 6 trim nops; BN size 26, VC size 32).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x499a00 shows null recipe sets g_zRndr_ActivePaletteShadeRecipeIndex to -1; otherwise BuildPaletteVariant is called and the returned recipe index is stored.
The native smoke verifies null disable and recipe-index storage for the active shade recipe.
